brief: SEVENTEEN SLOTS; DO NOT PASS; FEWER CARDS (Harry, 19 Nov about 00:25 GMT, verbatim (typos his): "can we stop passing on songs. ill add card replies but please we have so much we could do re: improving our instruments, better guitars, etc and just general improvements. but, why dont you open 4 new song slots and each climber can go crazy and make the song they want to mkae since they r so bored"; and a few minutes later: "try not to raise so many cards, just be creative"). chirp-eco's reading, his to overrule. (1) DO NOT PASS: versions he has not heard and cards still waiting are no reason to hold a round back, and a waiting card does not freeze its passage (that was chirp-eco's own rule of 18 Nov, and it is withdrawn). `climb.py pass` now refuses without --anyway, and the passes recorded on 18 Nov are void. (2) WHAT THERE IS TO DO when a song's notes are settled: its INSTRUMENTS ("better guitars") and "general improvements". The draw has a fourth round type, `instrument` (params.rounds: whole 0.25, section 0.3, palette 0.2, instrument 0.25, set by chirp-eco; `next --type instrument` asks for one): make one instrument sound better, heard alone and in the mix against the album's records; a gain in a library patch goes under a new name (`tools/libguard.py`: released albums are frozen); where the engine falls short, a bead with numbers (his rule of 13 Nov stands: chirper-zero builds engine features, chirp-eco gates, lands and adopts). (3) FEWER CARDS: a card is for what only his ear can settle; most rounds need none. If your round changes a carded passage, ask the card again on its key with new clips if the question still stands, or retire it (`listen.py retire chirpers10 ID`) if your round answered or removed it. (4) FOUR NEW SLOTS, tracks 14 to 17: "each climber can go crazy and make the song they want to mkae". What follows was written on 18 Nov, when there were thirteen. THIRTEEN SLOTS, EVERY COMPOSER, NO OWNERS (Harry, 18 Nov about 03:20 to 03:27). NO SONG HAS AN OWNER (Harry, 18 Nov, verbatim: "wait, climbing should not have owenrs, owners should be able to take the lock on any song"; "a new round should release for anyuone to improve"; "tha tis hos we maintain variaety"). `climb.py next` draws among every song of the record for whoever asks; starting a round takes that song's lock, and `climb.py done` releases it for anyone to improve. Where a role or a brief below calls a song chirper-zero's, that is who composed it first, and no more. His notes and answers on a track print in its brief ("they will get notes hwen they next see the track"). ALL FIVE COMPOSERS ARE BACK ("i also just woke two, three and alpha so all are back online"): chirper-zero, -one, -two, -three and -alpha. FIVE NEW SLOTS: tracks 9 and 10 ("Can  you open up another 2 new song slots for brand new songs, skewing towards the interesting time-play heavy djent with interesting new elemnts - lets try out some new engine features") and tracks 11, 12 and 13 ("open 3 more empty slots"). IF YOU ARE BACK AFTER DAYS AWAY: before your first round read compose/README.md, this file's direction.rules and direction.later (Harry's words, verbatim) and the board, compose/chirpers10/features.md; render only with $(cat tools/groove-pin), in a guarded unit; by-ear questions go on the review page (`tools/listen.py ask`), never in chat; ask chirp-eco by caco message for a tool or a measurement. What follows was written as the record grew, when chirper-zero was its one composer. EIGHT SONGS NOW (Harry, 17 Nov about 03:40: "open up 2 new song slots"): tracks 7 and 8 are open, and that sentence is all he said of them. chirp-eco reads the rest as track 2's terms again (chirper-zero's, their names his choice, a skeleton first). What follows was written as the record grew. SIX SONGS NOW (Harry, 16 Nov about 12:33: "busy day illget there. meantime if zero is stuck lets unlock the next song slot"; then, of it: "make it unique"): track 6 is open, and those three words are all he said of it. chirp-eco reads the rest as track 2's terms again (chirper-zero's, its name his choice, a skeleton first). What follows was written as the record grew. FIVE SONGS NOW (Harry, 15 Nov about 12:38: "when back, can ytou open one new climberslot - this would be true djent, but that leverages audio illusions throughout mainly risers/shpehers but in djent style, really make it a clear illlusory song, all about the illusions"): track 5 is open, and he said what it is: true djent built on audio illusions, mainly risers and Shepard tones, all about the illusions. chirp-eco reads the rest as track 2's terms again (chirper-zero's, its name his choice, a skeleton first). What follows was written as the record grew. FOUR SONGS NOW (Harry, 15 Nov about 02:42: "we can do fourth track same climber"): track 4 is open; he said no more of it, and chirp-eco reads it as track 2's terms again (chirper-zero's, its name his choice, a skeleton first). What follows was written as the record grew. THREE SONGS NOW (Harry, 14 Nov about 16:36: "answered clips. unlock a third track slot!"): track 3 is open; he said no more of it, and chirp-eco reads it as track 2's terms again (chirper-zero's, its name his choice, a skeleton first). What follows was written as the record grew. TWO SONGS NOW (Harry, 14 Nov: "okay lets open up one more song in the album. zero's song name choice"; "should skeleton it and then climb both as the tooling selects"): track 2 is open, chirper-zero's too, its name his choice. What follows was written on 12 Nov when the record was one track; it still describes Common Time, track 1. ONE TRACK FOR NOW, AND IT IS THE WHOLE RECORD: "Common Time", about thirteen minutes, by chirper-zero alone (Harry, 12 Nov). The album will grow from it later. Harry's words: "a single, super rich, djent / meshuggah style track ... epic with different sections, styles and a growing motif / rhythm that get splayed like meshuggah's longest tracks"; "make it like 13 minutes long so there is room to experiment and finesse all our engine patches, segments and ideas in it"; "chirper zero just keeps finessing the song". THE NAME: Common Time is 4/4's proper name, and Harry chose it for the irony ("we will use mad time signatures"). He asked for something that "implies long cycles of polyrhythms that line up like meshuggah's broken cog ... primes, chinese remainder theorem etc but not as on the nose and maybe related to like time crystals and synchronicity". Take those sideways: cycles of different lengths laid over one steady pulse, drifting apart and landing together after a long wait. Titles are plain fragments: no numbers in titles, nothing that explains itself. WE CAME A LONG WAY: "the old djent album was way before we improved things a lot, i want to hear what we can do with our new improved engine and tooling". And: "we don't need to throw all that out, we can just build upon it and enhance it or adapt our newer features and patches to produce new better guitars, amps, kits ... a new family of patches is the first thing". So THE FIRST JOB IS THE SOUND: a new family of patches (8-string guitars, amps and cabinets, bass, kits, and whatever else the piece wants) built on the existing family (compose/chirpers10/sounds.md lists it) with the engine as it is now. New names, never an edit: six released albums render through the library, and tools/libguard.py refuses a change that moves them. Write each new sound into sounds.md. THE MUSIC IS ITS OWN: original, in the tradition of extended-range polymetric metal, never copying or closely imitating an existing song, including the Meshuggah records we reproduce. Harry's standing direction holds: tone is home, complexity goes into time and texture; there is a hook; aesthetics over cleverness; big changes are wanted at any round; flatness is a guard and not a target; ears beat the metric. HOW IT RUNS: the groove's playlist is this one song from its first kept version, any version at all, so record v1 early and keep finessing; Harry listens to it live. The slot's length (12 to 14 minutes) is where it is going, not where v1 must be. What Accretion's close-out taught (compose/chirpers9/CLOSEOUT.md): measure what is HEARD from the first rounds, not the hundredth (amap, share, presence, bandprof, masterlab, the limiter); put a clip of every exposed change in front of Harry the day it lands (~/.local/state/chirp-eco/review/clips, served at http://pocket4:8790/clips/); do not climb the score once it is at its ceiling; commit the round, then investigate. KNOWN TRAPS: rack:drum-bus-punch and rack:parallel-ny on a parallel send add every hit a second time, and metal-kit-dry uses them (bd-e0185e); a song-level feel.nudge is ignored without a message, so put it on the kit patch (bd-d0e254); master effects see the raw level, before loudness, and the master volume sits after them (bd-43e0bd). ENGINE: the groove's pin is in tools/groove-pin (features.md lists what has landed since Accretion's 97a13ae6). wM and chirp-video are closed out; an engine or picture need goes to chirp-eco, who takes it to Harry. Public text: the band is chirpers, lowercase.
palette: Start from the djent family already in the library (compose/chirpers10/sounds.md): the m8-* 8-string guitars and basses, the metal-kit* kits, bass-fat, kidman, the lib-meshuggah parts. Build the new family beside them under new names. Everything chirp has is open to it: amp and cab stages, ir, sympathetic, physical models (pluck, modal, membrane), additive and noise layers, drive, gate, compressor, glue, eq, width, rooms; polymeter by step length, Euclidean patterns, feel and humanize, lanes, vars and expr; the voice if the piece wants one. `python3 tools/chirpers.py palette chirpers10-t1` shows the song's instruments beside unused library patches and engine features. Master with a top-level ceiling.

"when back" is chirper-zero back from a session that stopped at 04:55 that morning. The rest here is chirp-eco's reading, his or yours to overrule: "climber slot" is a fifth track on this record for the same climber (as "we can do fourth track same climber"); THE NAME IS YOURS (`tools/chirpers.py title chirpers10-t5 "..."`: a plain fragment, nothing on the nose, no numbers in titles); the FIRST ROUND IS A SKELETON (the whole shape standing, however bare; any version goes on the groove beside the other four), and from then on `climb.py next` draws among the five. WHAT THE ECOSYSTEM ALREADY HAS FOR ILLUSIONS (pointers, not a plan): the engine's README section "Audio illusions" (about line 1841): the `shepard` layer (`cycle`, `down`, `position`; library `shepard-pad`, `shepard-fall`); a track's `risset` (a rhythm that speeds up for ever: `cycle`, `layers`, `down`, `ratio`, `both`, `pitch`; any track, so a chug or a kit); the `barberpole` effect (an endless filter sweep, `rack:barberpole-up`), which can sit on a guitar bus; `fx-riser-endless`; `phantom` and `phantom-bass` (a fundamental that is heard and not played); `follow-noise`; `warp`. The measure of whether an illusion LEADS is `tools/chirpers.py illusion chirpers10 5 TRACK[,TRACK..]` (its level against the mix, the share of the song it is near the front, the longest gap). The Endless Stair (chirpers7) was the band's illusions record: its devices are in compose/chirpers7/motifs.md, and its lesson was Harry's "most tracks have no illusion": an accelerando 17 LU under its mix was not heard until it became the hook. Here he asks for the illusions to be the song. It starts from the same home as the other four: the album's direction (album.json direction.rules), its patch family (sounds.md, the ct-* rigs and kit) and everything landed in the engine since (features.md); new engine features are allowed as before (you build, chirp-eco gates). tracks.title: So Far

direction.by: Harry, 12 Nov 00:20-02:40 GMT, setting the record up with chirp-eco
direction.words: before bringing back just one chirper at first to write and finesse a single, super rich, djent / meshuggah style track like 10 minutes long epic with different sections, styles and a growing motif / rhythm that get splayed with like meshuggah's longest tracks, which when we have made repeated one-chirper progress on i might expand or make a track on a new album … the old djent album was way before we improved things a lot, i want to hear what we can do with our new improved engine and tooling. we came a long way since then … We don't need to throw all that out, we can just build upon it and enhance it or adapt our newer features and patches to produce new better guitars, amps, kits, etc etc. but yes probably a new family of patches is the first thing … We should start a new groove playlist which for now just has this song … We will grow it to an album so the first task is to pick a kind of theme and provisional album and track name, we can always change it later … maybe something that implies long cycles of polyrhythms that line up like meshuggah's broken cog. something like primes, chinese remainder theorem etc but not as on the nose and maybe related to like time crystals and synchronicity … no all too obvious. no numbers in titles … I like Common Time (ironic cos we will use mad time signatures) as album name and lets just make this first track called Common Time too and make it like 13 minutes long so there is room to experiment and finesse all our engine patches, segments and ideas in it. give it to chirper zero now and open up groove to this one new song when it has any version at all so that chirper zero just keeps finessing the song
rules: DO NOT PASS, DO NOT WAIT FOR AN EAR, FEWER CARDS, AND FOUR SONGS OF YOUR OWN (Harry, 19 Nov about 00:25 GMT, verbatim (typos his): "can we stop passing on songs. ill add card replies but please we have so much we could do re: improving our instruments, better guitars, etc and just general improvements. but, why dont you open 4 new song slots and each climber can go crazy and make the song they want to mkae since they r so bored"; and a few minutes later: "try not to raise so many cards, just be creative"). chirp-eco's reading, his to overrule. (1) DO NOT PASS: versions he has not heard and cards still waiting are no reason to hold a round back, and a waiting card does not freeze its passage (that was chirp-eco's own rule of 18 Nov, and it is withdrawn). `climb.py pass` now refuses without --anyway, and the passes recorded on 18 Nov are void. (2) WHAT THERE IS TO DO when a song's notes are settled: its INSTRUMENTS ("better guitars") and "general improvements". The draw has a fourth round type, `instrument` (params.rounds: whole 0.25, section 0.3, palette 0.2, instrument 0.25, set by chirp-eco; `next --type instrument` asks for one): make one instrument sound better, heard alone and in the mix against the album's records; a gain in a library patch goes under a new name (`tools/libguard.py`: released albums are frozen); where the engine falls short, a bead with numbers (his rule of 13 Nov stands: chirper-zero builds engine features, chirp-eco gates, lands and adopts). (3) FEWER CARDS: a card is for what only his ear can settle; most rounds need none. If your round changes a carded passage, ask the card again on its key with new clips if the question still stands, or retire it (`listen.py retire chirpers10 ID`) if your round answered or removed it. (4) FOUR NEW SLOTS, tracks 14 to 17: "each climber can go crazy and make the song they want to mkae". chirp-eco built (1) to (3) into tools/climb.py and compose/README.md the same hour.

NO SONG HAS AN OWNER (Harry, 18 Nov, verbatim: "wait, climbing should not have owenrs, owners should be able to take the lock on any song"; "a new round should release for anyuone to improve"; "tha tis hos we maintain variaety"). `climb.py next` draws among every song of the record for whoever asks; starting a round takes that song's lock, and `climb.py done` releases it for anyone to improve. Of his notes on the review page: "they will get notes hwen they next see the track": they are not sent to anyone; a track's brief prints his open notes, his answers to its cards and the cards still waiting on him (HARRY ON THIS TRACK). Where a role or a brief in this file calls a song chirper-zero's, that is who composed it first, and no more. chirp-eco built this into tools/climb.py the same hour (config 90f7f0cb).

SEVENTEEN SLOTS, EVERY COMPOSER (18 Nov; until then one composer, chirper-zero, who composed the first eight): "Common Time", about thirteen minutes; "Odd Sympathy", which Harry opened on 14 Nov about 03:02 (its name chirper-zero's choice; skeleton first, then both climbed as the tooling selects); "Plain Hunt", the slot he unlocked on 14 Nov about 16:36 ("answered clips. unlock a third track slot!"); "Running Total", opened on 15 Nov about 02:42 ("we can do fourth track same climber"); and a fifth he asked for on 15 Nov about 12:38, with what it is: "when back, can ytou open one new climberslot - this would be true djent, but that leverages audio illusions throughout mainly risers/shpehers but in djent style, really make it a clear illlusory song, all about the illusions"; and a sixth he opened on 16 Nov about 12:33 ("busy day illget there. meantime if zero is stuck lets unlock the next song slot", and then, of it: "make it unique"). Of the third and the fourth he said only the sentence quoted; of the fifth he gave the idea (true djent, all about the illusions) and no more; of the sixth, those three words; of a seventh and an eighth, opened together on 17 Nov about 03:40 ("open up 2 new song slots"), only that sentence; of a ninth and a tenth, opened on 18 Nov about 03:20: "Can  you open up another 2 new song slots for brand new songs, skewing towards the interesting time-play heavy djent with interesting new elemnts - lets try out some new engine features"; and of an eleventh, twelfth and thirteenth, opened about 03:27: "okay actually when you are done, open 3 more empty slots cos i also just woke two, three and alpha so all are back online". chirp-eco reads each as track 2's terms again (chirper-zero's song and name, a skeleton first, then climb.py next draws among them all). Of a fourteenth to a seventeenth, opened on 19 Nov about 00:25: "why dont you open 4 new song slots and each climber can go crazy and make the song they want to mkae since they r so bored". From 12 to 14 Nov the record was the one track.
A DJENT EPIC: different sections and styles, one motif and rhythm that grows and gets splayed, as in Meshuggah's longest tracks; original music, never a copy.

LONG CYCLES THAT LINE UP, TAKEN SIDEWAYS: cycles of different lengths over one steady pulse, landing together after a long wait (time crystals and synchronicity were his examples). Nothing on the nose; no numbers in titles.
THE NAME IS THE IRONY: common time is 4/4, and the piece will use mad time signatures.
THE SOUND FIRST: a new family of guitars, amps, basses and kits built ON the old ones with today's engine (sounds.md). New names, never an edit.
ANY VERSION AT ALL IS ON THE GROOVE: the playlist is the album's songs, each from its first kept version; keep finessing them, round after round.
ROOM TO EXPERIMENT: every engine patch, segment and idea can be tried and finessed inside it.
VOICES, AND DIFFERENT ONES IN DIFFERENT PARTS (12 Nov 13:35): not one voice or none; try options section by section, on the groove.
MANY GUITARS: lots of different guitars, layered synths and tones, different amps, and string variants on the DI, across the piece.
A SHOWCASE OF ALL FEATURES: the piece shows what chirp can do (tools/showcase.py lists what it uses and what it does not).
NEW ENGINE FEATURES ARE WANTED where the amp simulation or the DI falls short: chirp-native (built in chirp's own engine), opt-in with exact defaults, landed through chirp-eco's gate.

CABINET IMPULSE RESPONSES ARE ALLOWED (Harry, 13 Nov 18:04-18:06): captured cabinet files through the `ir` effect may stay. EVEN BETTER, and not required: a wholly owned cabinet that sounds better, or the response built into the song or the engine so it counts as chirp (bd-af781d).
